# Welcome to Wallshift 👋
Wallshift is built to make wallpaper management easier, save your time, and provide a convenient way to automatically change your desktop wallpaper.
Our goal is simple: **less manual work, more convenience, and a better desktop experience.**

By installing Wallshift, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the terms and conditions of the application's license.
**If you agree to the license terms, you may continue with the installation. If you do not agree, please cancel the installation.**
You can review the license in the `LICENSE` file included with the application.

## 🔒 Your Security Matters
Wallshift encourages responsible and privacy-conscious software usage. Your system's security is important, and you should always know what you are installing.
- **Always inspect installation scripts** before running them.
- Review the source code and understand what commands will be executed on your system.
- Install software only from sources you trust.
- Check dependencies and requested permissions before proceeding.
- Never blindly execute scripts just because they come from a package manager or repository.
Even when using a trusted package manager, take a moment to verify the software and its installation instructions.

## ⚡ Built for Convenience
Wallshift is created to simplify your workflow, reduce repetitive tasks, and save time. It is designed to make automatic wallpaper management straightforward, so you can spend less time managing your desktop and more time doing what matters.
Thank you for choosing Wallshift!
**Use responsibly. Stay informed. Keep your system secure.** ❤️
